snippet.title: Golden Axe III Gameplay (Mega Drive, Japan)
snippet.description:
Title: Golden Axe III
Platform: Mega Drive
Region: Japan
Type: Gameplay
Developer/Publisher: Sega
Release: June 25, 1993
Footage captured by: @ChronoCache 

Golden Axe III for the Sega Mega Drive, released in 1993, is the third installment in the popular beat 'em up series. Set in a mythical world filled with magic and danger, players choose from four unique characters: a barbarian, a swordsman, an Amazon warrior, and a humanoid panther. The game features improved graphics and gameplay mechanics compared to its predecessors, offering branching paths, special attacks, and cooperative multiplayer mode. The main objective is to defeat the evil forces of the demon lord Damned Hellstrike and restore peace to the land. Despite mixed reviews, Golden Axe III remains a nostalgic classic for fans of retro gaming.

Mega Drive Games (Japan, Part 1) - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-Jlu2SO_HDI_sZxlsft7AG2ZqmpTWqdT
